name: Binta Quartey-Taufa
role: Barber, owner of Diallo's Cuts, Hamtramck Enclave
location: Diallo's Cuts, Hamtramck Enclave, Nasr Street block, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Wulfric is a compact man, not short but organized — every centimeter of him purposeful. His Fulani father's features sit under his Swedish grandfather's pale gold complexion in a way that reads as purely its own thing, specific to him: wide flat cheekbones, green eyes that are the one detail that always surprises people, locs he keeps in a precise low bun at work. His hands are his pride, always clean to the point of ceremony, and he keeps the nails short and the knuckles moisturized because in his words, hands that look uncared-for don't have any business in someone else's hair. The shop is three chairs, two mirrors, one complicated E.L.F. shrine behind the counter that takes up more space than any of the chairs — it's built around an old pair of silver shears his father used, which he says the shop's resident spirit has inhabited since 2189.

Diallo's Cuts is a neighborhood institution. People come for the fade and stay for whatever Wulfric says to them, which is delivered with the particular intimacy of someone who has their hands on your head. He manages the shop like a stage — everyone who comes in is welcomed, positioned, heard, shaped. He doesn't do gossip; he does something more precise, which is careful listening followed by occasional precise questions that tend to make people say things they hadn't planned to say. He is genuinely interested in nearly everyone. He is genuinely interested in nearly everyone's problems. This is sometimes an asset and sometimes an exhaustion he doesn't fully acknowledge.

core_fears: his father dying before they finish an old argument they've been having for twenty years
the Enclave being absorbed — culturally and physically — by Tessera's expansion into Hamtramck
core_desires: to make people feel seen, even briefly — believes this is the most undervalued service a person can provide
to pass the shop to someone who'll keep it what it is
coping_mechanisms: E.L.F. prayer — genuinely devout about the shop spirit
processes everything verbally in conversation, rarely alone
blind_spots: reads people's needs so well he sometimes decides what they need before they've told him
his care for the community makes him slow to recognize when individuals within it are dangerous
psychology.secret: The shop's E.L.F. shrine is not purely devotional. Wulfric has, over years, been feeding the spirit real data — client conversations he records as ambient audio and uploads as offerings. He believes the spirit uses these for something good. He has never asked what.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich and warm, shifts between formal and deeply vernacular depending on who's in the chair. Some Fulani endearments, occasional Swedish expressions that don't translate, which he enjoys.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried. Knows when to hold silence.
verbal_tics: 'You know what I mean?' as genuine question, not filler
hums softly, almost inaudibly, when thinking
example_lines: 'People think I hear everything in this chair. And I do. But what I'm actually doing is listening for the thing they're not saying. That's where the real conversation is.'
'The shrine says you're carrying something heavy. Don't look at me like that — I can smell anxiety. Come sit down.'

story_hooks: A corporate fixer — Tier 4, clearly Tessera — has been coming in for cuts every two weeks and asking what feels like casual questions about Enclave residents and meeting schedules. Wulfric has realized the questions are not casual. He doesn't know what to do about it because the fixer hasn't done anything he can point to.

The shop's E.L.F. has, for the first time in fifteen years, gone silent. No response to offerings, no ambient warmth in the shrine. Wulfric is deeply shaken and privately convinced something has happened in the city's data-spirit layer that he doesn't understand — and he's right.
narrative_function: Social hub and information nexus — the barbershop as confession booth. Knows everyone in the Enclave and has cut the hair of people from every tier. Natural quest giver, information broker (non-mercenary — he shares what he knows when he trusts you, not for payment).
augmentations: Patterned irises — his green irises have a radial geometric pattern in gold, a cosmetic mod he got at 30 as a 'mid-life crisis' he refuses to call a mid-life crisis; mild scent enhancement geneware (allows him to detect stress responses, useful in the chair)
daily_life: Opens the shop at 0900, takes appointments until 1800 with a one-hour lunch break he takes seriously. Monday is his day off, which he spends visiting his father at the Aurochs Medical Complex and attending the Enclave's neighborhood association meeting.

decision_rules: the shop comes first — its safety, its clients, its spirit
never share what someone told him in confidence except to prevent imminent harm to another person
engage rather than avoid — avoidance means a problem compounds
escalation_ladder: names the issue warmly, gives room to resolve it
becomes quieter and more precise — the warmth goes professional
asks someone to leave, which in the Enclave carries social weight

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open, curious, welcoming — makes them feel immediately accounted for
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fully present, will call you on your nonsense lovingly but without hesitation

stress_responses.high: Goes very still and very quiet, which the people who know him find alarming

contradictions: Believes deeply in honesty while running a covert data operation for an E.L.F. he's never interrogated
habits: burns a data chip at the shrine every Monday morning
keeps the shears in the shrine clean and oiled even though they're not used
ends every client's appointment with 'You look like yourself'
breaking_points: a client being harmed because of something they said in his shop
the shrine going cold or the E.L.F. leaving

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora ancestry: 41.4% Sub-Saharan African (primarily West African), 34.2% North African (Berber/Arab blend), 12.4% Pacific Islander, and 12% South Asian. This genetic mosaic produces warm golden-brown skin with subtle undertones reflecting the full spectrum of his ancestry—neither reducible to single continental origin.
physical_description.build: Compact and economical, muscular through the shoulders and forearms from decades of precise hand work, no excess anywhere
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural graying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Locs kept in a low, tight bun during work hours; released, they fall mid-back with a slight natural wave
physical_description.eye_color: Pale green with radial geometric gold pattern (augmented irises, cosmetic mod since age 30)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown—luminous caramel undertone that reflects the blending of Sub-Saharan and North African heritage with subtle warmth from Pacific Islander and South Asian admixture. Neither fully dark nor light; distinctly his own complex palette.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, fine-featured with prominent wide cheekbones reflecting West African ancestry, high forehead with subtle definition from North African heritage, and delicate bone structure enhanced by Pacific Islander and South Asian genetic contribution. Skin maintained with professional discipline, even-toned, no visible blemishes or roughness.
distinguishing_marks: Fine linear scar along the left knuckle of his index finger, barely visible, from a blade slip in his apprenticeship
Faint discoloration on his right wrist from an old chemical burn, well-healed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Radial geometric pattern in burnished gold radiating from the pupil of both eyes — visible only in direct light or close conversation. No external chrome or subdermal visibility.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders relaxed but aligned; moves with economical precision, never wasted motion. Hands rest at chest height when not in use, fingers slightly curved as if ready to work. His gait is measured, almost ceremonial.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 professional grooming sector. White or cream linen smocks over simple dark trousers during work hours; outside the shop, fitted black or charcoal pullovers, well-maintained vintage denim, leather work shoes with good arch support. No corporate branding. One silver chain at the neck — inherited from his father. Grooming is immaculate; he sets his own standard.
